security_audit.summary: Static findings were reviewed against SKILL.md. The Ruby backtick, hardcoded URL, path traversal, and environment access detections are false positives from markdown fences, metadata URLs, repository links, and prose paths. The substantive concern is misuse potential because the skill helps design cold outbound email programs.

remediation.suggestion: Add explicit refusal language for requests that bypass consent, opt-out, suppression, or jurisdiction checks.

remediation.issue: Saved memory filenames may be based on user-provided sequence or ICP text.
remediation.suggestion: Require slug sanitization for saved filenames and reject path separators in the placeholder.

content.value_statement: Cold outbound teams need a sequence plan that protects deliverability and respects opt-out rules. This skill creates the sequence map, reply routing, warmup schedule, and compliance guardrails.
actual_capabilities: Creates a multi-step outbound sequence with timing, goals, and exit rules.
Designs reply triage for positive, objection, referral, not-now, and opt-out replies.
Plans mailbox and domain warmup with per-mailbox daily send caps.
Lists CAN-SPAM elements and opt-in jurisdiction guardrails as guidance.
Produces a SEND S-dimension deliverability read without computing EQS.
Creates a handoff summary for later review when the user confirms saving.
limitations: It does not provide legal advice or replace counsel review.
It does not write final email copy or verify live email headers.
It does not compute EQS or enforce auditor veto rules.
It needs user-provided list source, jurisdiction, domain, and mailbox details.

use_cases.title: Launch a Prospecting Sequence
use_cases.description: Plan a B2B sequence before sales development representatives start outreach.

use_cases.title: Prepare a New Sending Domain
use_cases.description: Create a warmup ramp and daily send throttle before a new campaign begins.

use_cases.title: Standardize Reply Handling
use_cases.description: Define routing for objections, referrals, not-now replies, opt-outs, and positive responses.

prompt_templates.title: Create a First Sequence
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a 5-step B2B cold outbound sequence for [ICP]. Use [list source], [mailbox setup], and [jurisdictions].

prompt_templates.title: Add Reply Routing
prompt_templates.prompt: Design reply triage for positive, objection, referral, not-now, and opt-out replies in this outbound program: [context].

prompt_templates.title: Plan Warmup Controls
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a domain warmup and per-mailbox daily send throttle for [domain age], [mailbox count], and [current volume].

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Full Launch Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this cold outbound plan for sequence gaps, reply routing, warmup, CAN-SPAM elements, opt-in jurisdictions, and SEND S risks: [plan].

output_examples.input: Plan a cold outbound campaign for finance operations leaders in the United States.
output_examples.output: A five-step sequence with clear timing, exit-on-reply rules, opt-out handling, and CAN-SPAM guardrails.

output_examples.input: I have three new mailboxes on a fresh domain and no sending history.
output_examples.output: A conservative weekly warmup ramp with daily caps, estimated labels, and checks for authentication and complaint signals.

output_examples.input: Route replies for positive interest, objections, referrals, not-now, and unsubscribe requests.
output_examples.output: A branch table that stops the main sequence on every reply and assigns the next operational action.

best_practices: Provide the list source, jurisdiction mix, mailbox count, domain age, and current warmup state.
Confirm consent basis and suppression handling before using any sequence at scale.
Pass the final plan to an email quality audit before launch.
anti_patterns: Do not use it to bypass opt-out, suppression, or consent requirements.
Do not treat the compliance guardrails as legal advice.
Do not run high-volume outreach from a new domain without warmup data or throttles.

faq.question: Does this skill write the email copy?
faq.answer: No. It designs the sequence structure, reply routing, warmup, throttles, and guardrails.

faq.question: Can it replace legal review?
faq.answer: No. Compliance guidance must be confirmed with qualified counsel for each jurisdiction.

faq.question: What inputs improve the output?
faq.answer: Provide the ICP, list source, jurisdiction mix, domain age, mailbox count, and current send metrics.

faq.question: Does it compute the final email quality score?
faq.answer: No. It reads the SEND S dimension and hands the plan to an auditor for scoring.

faq.question: How does it handle opt-out replies?
faq.answer: It stops the sequence, suppresses the contact, and hands the fact to the consent record process.

faq.question: Is it only for B2B cold outbound?
faq.answer: Yes. It is not intended for B2C lifecycle automation or consented nurture campaigns.
